text:
When the Dharma is at its final end and the lower realms increase,
the wise, having become deeply weary,
heedful, become fearful like a deer.
O King of Supreme Joy, compared with a bodhisattva who for a thousand eons practises the six perfections without skill in means, the former heap of merit does not approach even a hundredth part of this heap of merit of one who hears this samādhi and rejoices in it, up to: it does not approach even by way of comparison. When this Dharma discourse was taught, countless bodhisattvas generated the mind toward unsurpassed, perfect, complete awakening, and all of them became irreversible from unsurpassed, perfect, complete awakening. As many as eight hundred thousand of the assemblies of gods and human beings obtained, with respect to phenomena, the Dharma-eye, dustless, stainless and purified. Those gods, their Dharma-eye purified, rejoicing in the Dharma of the Blessed One, strewed the great trichiliocosm world-systems with flowers. The great trichiliocosm…
